exact_statement: Exists C<infinity such that for every n>=1 and every Boolean f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1} under uniform input, sum_{S subset [n]} fhat(S)^2 log_2(1/fhat(S)^2) <= C sum_{S subset [n]} |S| fhat(S)^2. Empty coefficient included; 0 log(1/0)=0. Constant C independent of n and f.
